enemies.name: Tax Frog
enemies.flavor: Ribbits in triplicate. Knows exactly what you owe. Down to the fly.

enemies.name: Licensed Bog Accountant
enemies.flavor: Half wizard, half ledger, entirely damp. His briefcase is a lily pad.

actions.name: Depreciate
actions.desc: Reduces your move time. Assets lose value over time.

actions.name: Itemize
actions.desc: Converts 3 orbs to Nature. Every deduction counted.

enemies.name: Audit Gator
enemies.flavor: See you later? No. He sees you NOW. Bring receipts.

actions.name: Receipt Chomp
actions.desc: A massive bite with supporting documentation.

enemies.name: Swamp Notary
enemies.flavor: Stamps things. Mostly documents. Occasionally adventurers.

actions.name: Blockade of Bureaucracy
actions.desc: Places a blocker on the board. Sign here first.

enemies.name: The Taxlord of the Bog
enemies.flavor: An ancient horror in a sensible cardigan. Death and taxes, in one convenient location.

actions.name: Final Notice
actions.desc: Enormous damage. You have been warned. Repeatedly.

actions.name: Loophole
actions.desc: Heals himself through a clause nobody read.
